title: Exosomal miR-499a-5p from human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells attenuates liver fibrosis via targeting ETS1/GPX4-mediated ferroptosis in hepatic stellate cells.
authors: Wang, Zheng; Yuan, Mengqin; Yao, Lichao; Xiong, Zhiyu; Dai, Kai; Liu, Pingji; Chen, Ping; Sun, Muhua; Shu, Kan; Xia, Yuchen; Jiang, Yingan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MSC外泌体miR-499a-5p通过ETS1/GPX4调控肝星状细胞铁死亡治疗肝纤维化，虽涉及ETS1转录因子与GPX4的分子对接，但核心是细胞表型与疾病机制，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法仅简单对接，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Liver fibrosis is a leading cause of liver-related mortality worldwide, yet effective therapies remain limited. Mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) have recently shown promise in treating liver fibrosis due to their anti-inflammatory and anti-fibrotic properties. However, the precise molecular mechanisms by which MSCs exert their effects remain unclear. In this study, we explored how human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells (hUC-MSCs) contribute to treating liver fibrosis, and revealed a crucial role of ferroptosis in modulating hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) activity. We found that MSCs primarily promote ferroptosis in HSCs in an exosome-dependent manner. Specifically, MSC-derived exosomes (MSC-Exos) deliver miR-499a-5p, which interacts with the transcription factor ETS1, leading to the suppression of GPX4, a key regulator of ferroptosis, thereby reducing the fibrogenic activity of HSCs. Overexpression of ETS1 in HSCs counteracted miR-499a-5p-induced ferroptosis, underscoring the pathway's potential as a target for therapeutic intervention. Furthermore, molecular docking simulations further identified optimal ETS1-GPX4 binding sites. This research uncovers a novel mechanism by which MSCs may treat liver fibrosis, providing insights that could guide the development of more effective therapies for this widespread condition.
abstract_zh: 肝纤维化是全球范围内肝相关死亡的主要原因，然而有效的治疗方法仍然有限。间充质干细胞（MSCs）因其抗炎和抗纤维化特性，近期在治疗肝纤维化方面显示出潜力。然而，MSCs发挥其作用的确切分子机制仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们探讨了人脐带来源的间充质干细胞（hUC-MSCs）如何有助于治疗肝纤维化，并揭示了铁死亡（ferroptosis）在调节肝星状细胞（HSCs）活性中的关键作用。我们发现，MSCs主要通过外泌体依赖性方式促进HSCs中的铁死亡。具体而言，MSC来源的外泌体（MSC-Exos）递送miR-499a-5p，其与转录因子ETS1相互作用，导致GPX4（铁死亡的关键调控因子）的抑制，从而降低HSCs的纤维化活性。HSCs中ETS1的过表达抵消了miR-499a-5p诱导的铁死亡，凸显了该通路作为治疗干预靶点的潜力。此外，分子对接模拟进一步确定了最优的ETS1-GPX4结合位点。本研究揭示了MSCs可能治疗肝纤维化的新机制，为开发针对这一广泛疾病更有效的疗法提供了见解。
